title: Connect to a ClickHouse data source in Grafana Cloud

blocks.content:
Welcome to the Grafana learning path for connecting a ClickHouse data source.

ClickHouse is a fast, open source, column-oriented database built for online analytical processing (OLAP). It excels at storing and querying huge volumes of logs, traces, and events, which makes it a popular backend for observability and analytics at scale. The ClickHouse data source lets you query and visualize that data directly in Grafana, using either a visual query builder or raw SQL.

This journey walks you through connecting Grafana Cloud to your ClickHouse server so you can query, visualize, and build dashboards from your ClickHouse data.

## Here's what to expect

When you complete this journey, you'll be able to:

- Understand why ClickHouse pairs well with Grafana for logs, traces, and analytics
- Create a read-only ClickHouse user that Grafana can use safely
- Add the ClickHouse data source plugin in Grafana Cloud
- Configure the connection details, protocol, and credentials for your ClickHouse server
- Save and test the connection, and recognize the most common connection errors
- Verify that your ClickHouse data returns by running a query in Explore

## Before you begin

Before you connect to a ClickHouse data source, ensure you have:

- A running ClickHouse server that Grafana Cloud can reach on its query port (Native: `9000`, or `9440` with TLS; HTTP: `8123`, or `8443` with TLS).
- A read-only ClickHouse user, or permission to create one (you'll set this up in this journey).
- The connection details for your server: host, port, username, and password.
- Organization administrator access in Grafana, which is required to add a data source.
- If your ClickHouse server sits behind a firewall, network access from Grafana Cloud (for example, an allowlist entry or a private data source connection).

## Troubleshooting

If you get stuck, help is close at hand. Where it's useful, this journey links to the relevant [ClickHouse data source troubleshooting](https://grafana.com/docs/plugins/grafana-clickhouse-datasource/latest/troubleshooting/) topics.

## More to explore

Where it makes sense, we'll point you to related capabilities such as the prebuilt OpenTelemetry dashboards and Drilldown apps so you can keep going after you're connected.
